notes.softwareRole: Offline-first viewer + logger companion for facility Postpartum Hemorrhage monitoring in Ethiopia PHCUs. Operates in first-class Demo mode on Expo/Android with zero hardware dependency, while fully adhering to the agreed ESP32 BLE protocol interface for seamless plug-and-play connection.
